description: The donut chart titled “Stimulus Type” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as referenced in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents “Draft/Other” at 26.4%. Following this, “Press Release” (18.7%, golden yellow) and “External News Article” (18.1%, dark green) are the next most substantial categories. Smaller segments include “Interview” (8.8%, dark blue), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, lavender), “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon), “Organizational Website” (4.9%, light purple), and “Intra-agency news article” (4.9%, medium blue). Even smaller proportions are shown for “Email” (2.7%, light green) and “Social Media Post” (1.1%, orange). Each segment is clearly labeled with its category and percentage, positioned radially around the chart, and the central white space contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold black text. The chart uses a color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling, and no segment is exploded or emphasized beyond its proportional size.
